verses.text: 142. By his Revelation, “the invisible God, from the fullness of his love, addresses men as his friends, and moves among them, in order to invite and receive them into his own company.” (DV 2; cf. Col 1:15; 1 Tim 1:17; Ex 33:11; Jn 15:14–15; Bar 3:38 (Vulg.).) The adequate response to this invitation is faith.
